decisions.decision: Roll recurring starts one period before the earliest B date (or today)
decisions.rationale: 2020-era ,R lines still expand every occurrence before Forecast slices at B; rewriting the text keeps the DSL honest and the walk short. Counted series left alone. Overrides remapped by date.
alternatives_considered: Anchor to today even when B is earlier

gotchas.issue: parseEntries walks every recurring occurrence from the text start to forecast end, then slices at the B line. Old starts (2020) are extra CPU and inflate #N indexes.
gotchas.resolution: Entries → Roll recurring starts rewrites unbounded series to one period before B. Optional later: skip generation before that period without changing the text.

gotchas.issue: Rolling a start remaps |#N= overrides; N is occurrence index from the text start, not a calendar date.
gotchas.resolution: Map old N → occurrence date → new index from the new start. Drop overrides whose date is before the new start. Do not roll counted series (RW5).
